_: HAND-WRITTEN FIXTURE, not survey data. It exists so tests/region-massing.test.mjs can run the exact placement the renderer runs before docs/data/region-osm.json is built, and so the cases that matter are each present exactly once rather than hoped for in a 10,000-row file. Every coordinate is chosen to exercise a rule, not to describe a real building: the shipped campus LiDAR grid spans x -1197..1842, z -1383..1383, so anything past x 3000 is unambiguously regional and anything near the origin is unambiguously inside the campus.

buildings._case: ordinary regional building, square, on flat ground
ring wound the OTHER way — walls must still face outward
closing vertex repeated, as OSM writes rings
on a slope — the roof must clear the highest ground under it
inside the campus box: the university's own massing draws this
too small to be worth 20 triangles at regional distance
no usable height — absent beats a 0 m flake of z-fighting roof
a second chunk, 500 m away, so chunking is observable

roads._case: an arterial straight through the campus box: the outside runs survive, the inside vertices do not
wholly inside the campus box — the survey already draws this street
unknown class: the way is real, its width is what is in doubt

water._case: inside the campus box — campus-world.js draws its own water
